method: Museum artwork and institutional catalogue object cross-check, with matching online composition previews where explicitly recorded; not raw SHA byte-image QA. Distinguishes user approval and reproduction rights. Score by iconography, artistic hierarchy, phone legibility, reuse and precise subevent.
policy: No unique art required per Bible event
Deep NT compare first, selective OT anchors
Highest-quality original reproduction and app-wide image rights separate
No El Greco or Fra Angelico new shortlist
No change to 101 selected works, live Bible ids, or 28 selected Bible subjects
Records with 'do not match' are negative safeguards, not art selections

records.subject: Flight into Egypt
records.title: The Flight into Egypt
records.assessment: The Pope Alexander VII-commissioned oil on copper shows Joseph assisting Mary and Child at the river crossing. Rich yet unusually clear vertical composition. Keep all three figures and tree; no cover crop.
records.rightsStatus: Met CC0 : verify exact packaged reproduction

records.subject: Baptism of Christ
records.title: The Baptism of Christ
records.assessment: Monumental oval painted surface: baptism gesture legible and figures centrally focused. Attractive restrained French classicist visual. Retain oval outline; avoid cutting angel on right.
records.rightsStatus: Met CC0 : verify exact packaged reproduction

records.subject: Calling the Fishermen
records.title: The Miraculous Draught of Fishes
records.assessment: Recognisable Luke 5 calling/catch of fishermen; exceptional Venetian colour and grouping. 243 cm wide, full-width landscape only, not portrait cover.
records.rightsStatus: NGA public-domain media : verify exact packaged reproduction

records.subject: Samaritan Woman
records.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
records.assessment: Finely finished oil on copper with intimate Christ/woman encounter, well evident. Met confirms this is a finished-work candidate, not merely unfinished sketch.
records.rightsStatus: Met CC0 : verify exact packaged reproduction

records.subject: Calming the Storm
records.title: Christ Asleep during the Tempest
records.assessment: Beautiful strong colour with Delacroix expressive painterly effect but Christ is ASLEEP, not rising to calm the storm. Optional supporting illustration, not mislabeled climax.

records.subject: The Prodigal Son
records.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
records.assessment: Exceptional emotional gravity, purposeful light, clear father/son figures. Exactly the return and forgiveness segment of Luke 15, not departure or dissipation. Seek high quality faithful photo and legal commercial terms.

records.subject: Christ and Martha and Mary
records.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary
records.assessment: Masterly bodegón, but the actual Luke 10 scene is a tiny background inset. Do not claim foreground women are literally the Biblical Martha and Mary; no mandatory specific image if no better painting found.

records.subject: Peter’s Confession
records.title: The Delivery of the Keys
records.assessment: Outstanding fresco of handing the keys in Matthew 16, but an architectural panorama, not an exact moment of Peter simply confessing Christ. Use only for Petrine primacy/keys-related stage, full fresco contain.

records.subject: Christ and Doubting Thomas
records.title: The Incredulity of St Thomas
records.assessment: Large painted John 20 encounter, Thomas touches the wound as disciples watch. Art quality/reproduction condition check required. Do not treat object title alone as image-visual approval.

records.subject: Road to Emmaus
records.title: The Supper at Emmaus
records.assessment: Extraordinarily strong tenebrist three-person reaction and fine table still-life. It paints Luke 24 recognition at supper; user may separately need illustration of earlier road journey, but no painting required for that subevent.
records.rightsStatus: Met CC0 : verify exact packaged reproduction

records.subject: Christ Feeds Peter’s Sheep
records.title: Christ's Charge to Peter
records.assessment: Raphael's c.1515–16 painted full-size tapestry cartoon: exceptionally important historic image, clear Resurrected Christ, Peter, sheep. Reuse ONE artwork for BIB-G23 and BIB-A20. Royal Loans photograph rights pending.
records.rightsStatus: V&A / Royal Collection Trust photo rights hold

records.subject: Washing of the Feet
records.title: The Washing of the Feet
records.assessment: Major Venetian original depicting John 13, extremely wide 210 x 533 cm; Christ/Peter near right edge. Full original is compelling; no phone-cover crop or arbitrary cutting of figures.

records.subject: Peter Heals the Lame Man
records.title: Saints Peter and John Healing the Lame Man
records.assessment: Highly ordered 1655 temple steps, colorful apostolic figures. Excellent exact Acts 3 narrative and significant museum-source quality. Main action central-left but not prominent at thumbnail; wide contain.

records.subject: Peter Raises Tabitha
records.title: The Raising of Tabitha
records.assessment: Rare actual oil depiction of Tabitha, but official museum states 'probably' this event; painting altered, extended and partly repainted. No automatic primary artistic recommendation.

records.subject: Paul at Lystra
records.title: Paul and Barnabas at Lystra
records.assessment: Strong large-figure Dutch Baroque narration of apostles stopping sacrifices after healing. Exact museum Pynas painting, not Rafael cartoon and not later stoning scene; preserve temple structure in horizontal frame.

records.subject: Paul at the Areopagus
records.artist: Flemish tapestry workshop after Raphael designs
records.title: Saint Paul Preaching at Athens
records.assessment: Excellent iconographic source: Raphael-designed Acts tapestry. The underlying asset is a woven tapestry, not an autograph canvas oil. Exact full reproduction and rights unresolved; use as a study candidate.

records.subject: The Flood
records.title: Winter (The Flood)
records.assessment: Exceptional dark atmospheric biblical Flood scene, biblical drowning survivors and lightning. Clearly evokes destruction, NOT rainbow covenant; high value single OT anchor across Noah's flood story.

records.subject: Crossing of the Red Sea
records.title: The Crossing of the Red Sea
records.assessment: Stunning 89-figure complex Baroque scene, exact Exodus 14 AFTER sea closes over pursuing Egyptians. Source shows restored painting; many small figures but ideal full-width anchor. Not artwork of first parting; do not reuse inaccurate caption.

records.subject: The Golden Calf
records.title: The Adoration of the Golden Calf
records.assessment: Companion to Poussin's Red Sea work, lively sacrilegious dance focused on golden idol; exact Exodus 32. Monumental 154 x 212 cm, readable full-width despite crowd, strong OT anchor.

records.subject: Joseph Forgives His Brothers
records.title: Joseph pardons his Brothers
records.assessment: Accurate Joseph's forgiveness, but extremely elongated Florentine 1515 furniture panel 36.2 x 141.6 cm; mobile only as horizontally navigable historic story, not hero. Can give one anchor for multiple Joseph sequence events with captions.

records.subject: Joseph Is Sold
records.title: Joseph sold to Potiphar
records.assessment: Critical identity exclusion: Genesis 39 sale to Potiphar AFTER arrival Egypt is NOT brothers selling Joseph to Ishmaelite traders in Genesis 37. May be reused for properly named separate narrative, not BIB-PA09.
